cloud-settings-desc: Ica WeKan ipan Weddy, in Cloud Panel quintlayecoltia miac WeKan domain ce servidor ipan, cecentetl ica itlahcuilol. Ipan ichan Cloud Panel, in SuperAdmin quinyacana in domain ihuan CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ica ce CloudFlare API tlatlapoloni, ce domain tlen izona ca ipan mocuenta CloudFlare quiceliz ce DNS tlahcuilolli ica proxy ihuan ce CloudFlare Origin amatl. Occequintin domain quiceliah ce Let's Encrypt amatl. In tlatlapoloni motlatia ipan servidor ihuan ayic occeppa monextiz.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Amo onca CloudFlare API tlatlapoloni omotlati: cecentetl domain quiceliz ce Let's Encrypt amatl.

csv-mapping-description: Xicpehpena tlanamactli itlaquetzal tlen quipia sesen amatlapalli itlal. Tlapehpenaliztli ochihualoc ica tlaquetzalli intocayo; xicpatla tlen amo melahuac, ihuan xicpehpena (amo ipan tlanamactli) para ce tlalli tlen tlanamactli amo quipia.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Tlanamactli amo quipia tlaquetzalli para tocatlahtolli. Xicpehpena ce icpac, noso xictlahcuilo itocayo inon san ce tocatlahtolli campa calaquiz nochi amatlapalli.
csv-mapping-list-required: Xictlahcuilo itocayo tocatlahtolli campa calaquiz nochi amatlapalli, noso xicpehpena tlaquetzalli tlen quipia tocatlahtolli.
csv-mapping-title-required: Xicpehpena tlaquetzalli tlen quipia amatlapaltin intocayo.
